HtmlUtil.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance by assigning a fixed set of string marker constants to object attributes for later symbolic use." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance on which the marker attributes are created and initialized."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-SPACE-' to self.SPACE_MARK. RESULT self.SPACE_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-JSON-' to self.JSON_MARK. RESULT self.JSON_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-MARKUP_LANGUAGE-' to self.MARKUP_LANGUAGE_MARK. RESULT self.MARKUP_LANGUAGE_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-URL-' to self.URL_MARK. RESULT self.URL_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-NUMBER-' to self.NUMBER_MARK. RESULT self.NUMBER_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-TRACE-' to self.TRACE_MARK. RESULT self.TRACE_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-COMMAND-' to self.COMMAND_MARK. RESULT self.COMMAND_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-COMMENT-' to self.COMMENT_MARK. RESULT self.COMMENT_MARK]
            [COMMAND Assign the string literal '-CODE-' to self.CODE_MARK. RESULT self.CODE_MARK]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
HtmlUtil.format_line_html_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Formats HTML text by marking code blocks, normalizing list and paragraph punctuation, decoding HTML entities, and returning line-feed-normalized plain text." format_line_html_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> html_text </REF>: text "HTML content to parse and normalize into formatted plain text."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: text "An empty string when the input is null or empty; otherwise decoded plain text extracted from the modified HTML and post-processed for line feeds."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Parse html_text with BeautifulSoup using the 'lxml' parser and store the parsed document as soup. RESULT soup]
            [COMMAND Find all 'pre' and 'blockquote' elements in soup and store them as code_tag. RESULT code_tag]
            [COMMAND For each tag in code_tag, replace its string content with self.CODE_MARK. RESULT updated_code_tags]
            [COMMAND Find all 'ul' and 'ol' elements in soup and store them as ul_ol_group. RESULT ul_ol_group]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over ul_ol_group, for each ul_ol_item, find all nested 'li' elements and store them as li_group. RESULT li_group]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loop over li_group, for each li_item, get its text, strip surrounding whitespace, and store it as li_item_text. RESULT li_item_text]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loop over li_group, if the length of li_item_text equals 0, continue to the next li_item without modifying li_item.string. RESULT skip_empty_li_item]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loop over li_group, if li_item_text is non-empty and its last character is in string.punctuation, set li_item.string to '[{0}]{1}'.format('-', li_item_text) and continue to the next li_item. RESULT punctuated_li_item]
            [COMMAND Within the nested loop over li_group, otherwise set li_item.string to '[{0}]{1}.'.format('-', li_item_text). RESULT formatted_li_item]
            [COMMAND Find all 'p' elements in soup and store them as p_group. RESULT p_group]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over p_group, for each p_item, get its text, strip surrounding whitespace, and store it as p_item_text. RESULT p_item_text]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over p_group, if p_item_text is empty, leave the paragraph unchanged and proceed to the next p_item. RESULT skip_empty_p_item]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over p_group, if p_item_text is non-empty and its last character is in string.punctuation, set p_item.string to p_item_text and continue to the next p_item. RESULT punctuated_p_item]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over p_group, otherwise find the next sibling of p_item and store it as next_sibling. RESULT next_sibling]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over p_group, if next_sibling exists and self.CODE_MARK is contained in next_sibling.get_text(), set p_item.string to p_item_text + ':' and continue to the next p_item. RESULT code_intro_p_item]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over p_group, otherwise set p_item.string to p_item_text + '.'. RESULT formatted_p_item]
            [COMMAND Extract all text from soup with soup.get_text(), decode HTML entities with gensim.utils.decode_htmlentities, and store the result as clean_text. RESULT clean_text]
            [COMMAND Return self.__format_line_feed(clean_text). RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: html_text is null or its length equals 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return an empty string immediately without parsing or further processing. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
HtmlUtil.extract_code_from_html_text:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extract text content from HTML code-related tags by counting code markers in a formatted HTML string and collecting non-empty text from matching pre or blockquote elements." extract_code_from_html_text]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> html_text </REF>: text "The raw HTML text to inspect for code markers and parse for pre or blockquote elements."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> code_list </REF>: list "A list of non-empty text values extracted from selected pre or blockquote elements, or an empty list when no code marker is present."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.format_line_html_text with html_text and store the formatted result in text_with_code_tag. RESULT text_with_code_tag]
            [COMMAND If self.CODE_MARK is not present in text_with_code_tag, return an empty list immediately. RESULT return_early_empty_list]
            [COMMAND Set code_index_start to 0 as the inclusive starting index for later iteration. RESULT code_index_start]
            [COMMAND Parse html_text with BeautifulSoup using the fixed parser 'lxml' and store the parsed document in soup. RESULT soup]
            [COMMAND Find all elements in soup whose tag name is either 'pre' or 'blockquote' and store the resulting collection in code_tag. RESULT code_tag]
            [COMMAND Count the number of occurrences of self.CODE_MARK in text_with_code_tag and store that integer in code_count. RESULT code_count]
            [COMMAND Initialize code_list as an empty list to accumulate extracted code text. RESULT code_list]
            [COMMAND For each code_index in range(code_index_start, code_index_start + code_count), using an inclusive lower bound of code_index_start and an exclusive upper bound of code_index_start + code_count, read code_tag[code_index], call get_text on that element, and store the extracted text in code. RESULT code]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, if code is truthy, append code to code_list; otherwise skip appending for that iteration. RESULT code_list]
            [COMMAND Return code_list after the loop completes. RESULT return_code_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.CODE_MARK is absent from text_with_code_tag after formatting html_text.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return an empty list without parsing HTML or scanning tags. RESULT return_empty_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: code_count is 0, so range(code_index_start, code_index_start + code_count) produces no iterations.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the loop body entirely and return the still-empty code_list. RESULT return_empty_code_list]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During a loop iteration, the extracted code value is falsy.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Do not append that code value to code_list and continue to the next index. RESULT skip_append]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
